pages.title: Holy Water
pages.text: The Ritual of Cleansing is a cure for the ascended. For everyone else, there is $(l)Holy Water$().$(br2)Drinking a bottle removes $(l)15 corruption$() and lifts the darkness. The body can only take so much purity at once: you must wait $(l)30 seconds$() between bottles.
Three bottles at a time. The bucket is returned.

pages.title: Splash Holy Water
pages.text: Add gunpowder and it can be thrown.$(br2)The splash burns the $(l)undead$() and the servants of the Hollow (Cultists, and the Sovereign himself) for heavy damage, and lifts $(l)8 corruption$() from every player it touches, the thrower included.
